REQ-311-03.requirement_text: - **REQ-311-03 — Database continuity.** Worker handlers and consumers SHALL use the existing `smartspec` database through scoped supported drivers and reviewed Hyperdrive/private connectivity. Verify database identity, TLS, least-privilege application credentials, transactions, connection cleanup, tenant isolation and reviewed writes. Do not run schema creation/migrations/seeding on request, consumer or cold startup; do not embed administration credentials in runtime configuration. Authentication and mutable authorization reads cannot use stale query-cache results.

REQ-311-10.requirement_text: - **REQ-311-10 — Transactional job intake.** Worker job intake SHALL atomically persist `worker_jobs` and its canonical outbox before publication to the existing Cloudflare Queue. Queue envelopes carry versioned job identity, tenant/project, attempt/dispatch references and integrity metadata needed by existing contracts, never copied secrets or large customer payloads. Publication failures leave recoverable outbox state. Reuse existing tables, contracts, credentials and publishers instead of creating a parallel job platform.

REQ-311-11.requirement_text: - **REQ-311-11 — Safe Queue consumption.** Worker consumers SHALL enforce existing tenant-scoped claim/lease/heartbeat/fencing and cancellation contracts. At-least-once delivery, non-ordered messages and crash boundaries cannot cause duplicate settlement or repeat external side effects; external idempotency keys/reconciliation are required where supported. Acknowledge only after durable terminal settlement or durable transfer of responsibility under an existing contract. Never promise globally exactly-once execution from Queue delivery alone.

REQ-311-12.requirement_text: - **REQ-311-12 — Full job coverage and recovery.** Every active canonical job type SHALL have a verified Worker-native executor or an explicitly resolved REQ-311-14 decision. Reuse existing retry/backoff, DLQ/quarantine, outbox sweep, expired-lease reconciliation, provider polling, scheduling and operator replay mechanisms; port required scheduling/control operations to Workers/Cron/Queues. Long jobs use durable bounded steps/provider async APIs, not detached promises. Poison messages cannot starve other tenants. DLQ retention/replay preserves identity, authority and attempt history.
